notes: Decision Index 0.3 latency per entrant (latency-v1 protocol, frozen 2026-09-26; index.json 2026-10-06T17:39:21Z). On-card rows: one sequential client, one process, 1 x RTX PRO 6000, model load excluded, the fastest path the model code supports (many entrants ran an author serving stack: see row caveat for latency_path). The Jev reference row is a HOSTED HTTPS ROUND TRIP from the board lab and is stored under separate hosted-rtt metric ids: the board says it is "Not comparable to the on-card single-process figures", so the 2.5x/13x "faster than Jev" ratios computed from 209.3/38.8 vs 524.1 ms mix quantities. Payload size, questions per request and region are not stated per entrant. Cloudflare self-reported 209.3/38.8 ms are in the Cloudflare launch doc; the board measures Clef at 102.1 ms and Clef-flash at 53.4 ms. 2026-11-26 re-read: live board is Decision Index 0.4.1 (index.json generated 2026-11-21T14:35:36Z); the latency-v1 protocol is unchanged (frozen 2026-09-26, same seed 20260926 and 750-row sample). 163 figures compared for the 60 matched entrants: on-card medians and means all unchanged; the hosted Jev reference RTT moved 524.1 -> 524 ms (p50) and 536 -> 536.1 ms (p95). 98 rows retired: methodology.json no longer publishes per-benchmark Jev http stats (benchmarks[].jev.http_median_ms / http_p95_ms are now all null); the four whole-run release-v1 http_wall/total_wall stats are still published and unchanged.
